evidence_quotes.O: Crazy how three years ago there were no wireless storage devices, and now we suddenly have multiple options.
evidence_quotes.C: I've tested in-house streaming and remote streaming to my laptop on WiFi and 3G and my smartphone on 3G.
evidence_quotes.E: It's hard to describe how happy I am about this product without sounding like an idiot.
evidence_quotes.A: Bottom line - if you need this for Android, look elsewhere, which is a shame, because it is well made and good to type on.
evidence_quotes.N: Which is annoying because it places it on a hidden partition swallowing up 13Gb of storage (of your 60Gb).
